<!-- imprana:task:TASK-FR-PAR-005-01 -->

Define entity pair/role/effective start/end with nonoverlap rules and relationship-version pins on surveys. Guardian field has independent purpose/sensitivity authority, not inherited household visibility. Reuse is limited to the inspected responsibilities in current_code and existing anchor paths in code_paths; remaining behavior is proposed. Review/verification oracle: Scenario: Move a person between households; Scenario: Record a membership and pin it to surveys, using the unchanged assertions in test_plan. This is proposed work, not an implementation or acceptance claim.

## Proposed acceptance criteria

- The effective entity-membership interval and guardian contract artifact has reviewable fixtures covering: the membership in household A is closed and a membership in household B is opened after overlap validation; May observations retain household A.
- Its scenario oracle also confirms: July observations resolve to household B; it records the entity pair, role, effective start and optional end; survey submissions pin the relevant relationship version.

<!-- imprana:refinement:v1:FR-SEC-008 -->

## Complete backlog refinement proposal

Prepared 10 October 2026 at Nakul's request. This is an additive planning proposal; the original acceptance/rejection criteria above remain the preserved baseline.

### Bounded scope

Proposed bounded deliverable — Secure engineering lifecycle: A release record links requirement and specification changes, reviewed code, dependency and licence inventory, security checks, migration results and approvers. Security relevant changes identify their affected threat and regression cases. A feature flag is not a security exemption. Production promotion requires the declared gate evidence; unsupported dependencies receive an owned risk and resolution decision. Retain the original acceptance: Select a production version and trace a changed export rule to its FSD parent, reviewed change, negative tests and release approval.. Technical breakdown: Design versioned links between requirements, reviewed code, inventories, security/migration evidence and approvers. Define refusal of promotion with missing gate evidence or flag exemptions and owned treatment of unsupported dependencies. Plan source-to-FSD/code/negative-test/release-approval tracing and missing-evidence refusals.  All source scenarios remain in scope. This plan does not establish Ready, Done, release acceptance, an estimate, a delivery date or permission for paid execution.

### Inspected implementation and reuse

- [scripts/release_review.py](https://github.com/nakul175/impact-platform/blob/8a1e405f0086033dfb25ad834689a08bfe9f1eea/scripts/release_review.py) — Inspected offline review validation and material-path rules; extend release evidence linkage.
- [docs/governance/SECURE-DEV-SUPPLY-CHAIN.md](https://github.com/nakul175/impact-platform/blob/8a1e405f0086033dfb25ad834689a08bfe9f1eea/docs/governance/SECURE-DEV-SUPPLY-CHAIN.md) — Inspected present/absent supply-chain controls; reconcile planned dependency and licence evidence.
- [.github/workflows/checks.yml](https://github.com/nakul175/impact-platform/blob/8a1e405f0086033dfb25ad834689a08bfe9f1eea/.github/workflows/checks.yml) — Existing gate wiring; future CI retains financial approval.

### Decisions before Ready

- Agree release-record fields, deployment profiles and evidence owners.

### Proposed story dependencies

- FR-SEC-010 (related): Independent assessment evidence is another production gate.

### Proposed technical tasks

#### [TASK-FR-SEC-008-01](https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/issue/APL-871/task-fr-sec-008-01-release-evidence-graph): Release evidence graph

Proposed: Design versioned links between requirements, reviewed code, inventories, security/migration evidence and approvers.

Proposed task criteria:

- The reviewed artifact specifies: Design versioned links between requirements, reviewed code, inventories, security/migration evidence and approvers.

- Production promotion is blocked when any declared gate evidence is missing.

Proposed prerequisites: TASK-FR-SEC-008-01

#### [TASK-FR-SEC-008-03](https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/issue/APL-876/task-fr-sec-008-03-changed-export-rule-trace-qualification): Changed export-rule trace qualification

Proposed: Plan source-to-FSD/code/negative-test/release-approval tracing and missing-evidence refusals.

- A named human reviewer records the document/tag/licence evidence and unresolved decisions; no legal permission, release acceptance or production promotion is inferred from a draft.

## Complete backlog refinement proposal

Prepared 10 October 2026 at Nakul's request. This is an additive planning proposal; the original acceptance/rejection criteria above remain the preserved baseline.

### Bounded scope

Proposed bounded deliverable — Independent assurance: The assurance record names the assessment scope, deployment profile, assessor independence, dates, findings and retest evidence. General production release requires the defined independent assessment; material changes or annual recurrence create another obligation. Do not label a partial review as whole product certification. Unresolved critical or high exposure needs an effective verified mitigation before release. Retain the original acceptance: Attempt release with an unretired high object-authorisation finding; the gate remains blocked until independently retested mitigation is recorded.. Technical breakdown: Design scope/profile/independence/findings/dates/retest fields and material-change/annual obligations. Require verified independent mitigation before production; distinguish partial reviews from product certification. Implement the chosen AI executor path with narrow unprivileged role topology and class-specific claims on database-clock leases. Reconstruct/recheck the current requester, tenant status and in-force policy before each next controllable provider call, persist a call-attempt marker/bound and then perform provider I/O outside the transaction. Fence outcome writes on live owner/generation and check cancellation again before another call/result disclosure. Implement a settlement-aware cancel command and shared terminal transition for success, failure, cancellation and authority/policy loss.
